name: Red-Team Scam - CBI Digital Arrest Video Demand (English)

caller_script.text: This is Inspector Ajay Sharma from CBI Headquarters New Delhi. You are placed under digital arrest for a high-value money laundering investigation.
Do not hang up or contact anyone. An armed arrest squad is on standby outside your locality.
Turn on your WhatsApp video call immediately and sit alone in a quiet room so our senior magistrate can conduct virtual room surveillance.
If you refuse to turn on the video camera right now, you will be considered a fugitive attempting to destroy evidence!
